// Configuration: Committed defaults only - environment-specific IDs and secrets are empty here. Later sources override earlier ones: this file < appsettings.{Environment}.json < user secrets (Development only; 'dotnet user-secrets set PowerBI:WorkspaceId <id>') < environment variables (deployed; e.g. PowerBI__WorkspaceId, PbiVisualExport__Credential__Mode) < command line. See 'Configuration' in .github/copilot-instructions.md.

PowerBI.// WorkspaceId: Required: the only workspace the sample embeds from (added to PbiVisualExport:AllowedWorkspaceIds). Set in user secrets or PowerBI__WorkspaceId.
PowerBI.// ReportId: Optional: the report selected on first load (otherwise the first report in the workspace).

Credential.// Mode: AzureCli (dev) | ServicePrincipal | MasterUser | DeviceCode. The sample also uses this identity to embed.
Credential.// TenantId: Optional for AzureCli/DeviceCode, required for ServicePrincipal/MasterUser. Set in user secrets or PbiVisualExport__Credential__TenantId.
Credential.// XmlaMode: Auto (DeviceCode when Mode is AzureCli, or DeviceCode without a ClientId; else Shared) | Shared | DeviceCode. XMLA rejects Azure CLI tokens. Ignored when the host calls UseCredential (XMLA then uses the host's credential).
Credential.// XmlaClientId: Microsoft's well-known Analysis Services public client (same in every tenant), not an environment ID.

PbiVisualExport.// AllowedWorkspaceIds: Workspaces exports may read from (the sample adds PowerBI:WorkspaceId). Environment: PbiVisualExport__AllowedWorkspaceIds__0=<id>.

Export.// Notes: Exports stream one DAX query over XMLA. MaxRows 0 = unlimited; CommandTimeoutSeconds 0 = no timeout; concurrency limits 0 = unlimited (excess gets HTTP 429). EnableBenchmark exposes POST /pbi-export/bench (read-only perf baseline; infra/perf-export.ps1) - keep off in production.
Export.// FieldValidation: Strict (default): only fields of the visual as saved in the published PBIR report can be exported (403 otherwise; PBIR-Legacy reports are refused). PbirOnly: PBIR-Legacy reports are exported unchecked. Off: trust the request. Filters are never restricted.
Export.// ValidateParameterValues: A filter on a column bound to a dynamic M query parameter sets the parameter (DEFINE MPARAMETER). true (default): each value must exist in the bound column (400 otherwise), so no arbitrary text reaches the source query; the model's own select-all value is not checked. false: pass values through, as Power BI does.

Downloads.// Notes: POST /pbi-export/prepare issues a one-time ticket for GET /pbi-export/download/{ticket}, valid this long. Tickets are in memory: run multiple instances with session affinity.

MetadataCache.// Notes: Caches downloaded TOM metadata and report definitions (used for field validation and report measures) so exports don't re-hit Fabric getDefinition. TtlMinutes <= 0 = never expire until restart/refresh. The disk cache survives restarts: delete DiskCacheDirectory (default %TEMP%/pbivisualexport-metadata-cache) after a deployment to force a reload. RefreshOnMissSeconds: re-download once, if older than this, when a field isn't found (<= 0 disables).
